sents.t: Ryan Hulse writes, "So I was just sitting at home alone. The parents were out, and I kept hearing the weird sounds again.
sents.zh: Ryan Hulse 写道：“我一个人坐在家里，爸妈都出去了，我又一直听到那些奇怪的声音。

sents.t: But this time, I decided to record for a change, and this is what I caught. Really creepy."
sents.zh: 但这次我决定换个做法，把它录下来，这就是我拍到的。真的很吓人。”

sents.t: What the f—? This is what I mean. Crazy.
sents.zh: 什么鬼？我说的就是这个。太疯狂了。

sents.t: Perhaps this might have been a stranger who broke in.
sents.zh: 这也许是一个闯进来的陌生人。

sents.t: Intruder or ghost, it's unknown as to who or what was inside Ryan's house.
sents.zh: 是入侵者还是鬼？没人知道当时 Ryan 家里的是谁、是什么。
